description: Implement draft-ietf-jmap-contacts-10 + RFC 9553 (JSContact) data types. Types only — no async. Structs: AddressBook (id, name, description, isSubscribed, shareWith, myRights, totalContacts), AddressBookRights (mayRead/Write/Share/Delete booleans), ContactCard (full JSContact Card + JMAP id + addressBookIds), all JSContact sub-objects (Name, Nickname, Email, Phone, Address, Organization, etc.), ContactCardFilterCondition with slash-keyed fields (name/given etc.). All fields camelCase serde. Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-contacts-10 + RFC 9553. Pattern: follow jmap-mail-types.
title: jmap-contacts-types: JSContact + JMAP Contacts data types
